runs.t: Blessed art Thou oh L-rd, who sanctifies His nation of Israel
arriage is the single most important event in most people's lives: the choice of spouse,
monetary expenditures, social and family ramifications on future offspring all depend on this
night. The quality and substance of life rests on this night. Our deepest thoughts, justifiably, are
invested in these subjects. Following this night our life is changed forever.
It follows that the choice of a Rabbi to officiate be approached with the same gravity. A
differentiation between the levels of knowledge of Rabbis within the orthodox circle will not be
drawn here. That point is mainly academic. It must, however, be pointed out that only an
orthodox Rabbi should be entrusted to perform the wedding. Only he can be expected to have
the knowledge, fear of G-d and compliance with halacha required to perform the ceremony
within the letter of the law and with no unnecessary halachic complications.
